protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: on 64-bit Linux, an SCM_RIGHTS cmsg with two ints has cmsg_len 24 and fits the 24-byte CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int)) receive buffer without MSG_CTRUNC; the exact CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int)) equality rejects it after both fds are installed, closes neither, retries recvmsg, and the Java EAGAIN-to-0 path exits the read loop. FILE_DESCRIPTORS mode makes this reachable for epoll and kqueue domain sockets.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 3030b4afe30f96b59807b24bd4f5250d41de283f is the single-parent, affected-lineage first write of the exact-length check, retry loop, missing MSG_CTRUNC handling, EAGAIN mapping, and FILE_DESCRIPTORS reachability; the change is a coherent feature commit, not a move or aggregate requiring a finer public member.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: f771a97592d95d70cbb6f6b5afb6e4a3a450a499 has a one-shot recvFd with MSG_CTRUNC handling, no CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int)) equality, and no DomainSocketReadMode.FILE_DESCRIPTORS; case-specific grep of its C and Java tree found neither latter construct.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: the BIC has exactly one parent and directly introduces the vulnerable feature. Same-message commits 495fa6be3cf725a0abc68cefd71116ab718fff3e and cabecee127264e53acaa093ca45d3900b138b881 are separate lineages and are not ancestors of the affected 4.1/4.2 tags; 075a54af3e607c20eeaf7809a2a08602abd5d735 and 3cc405296310643bccddc8c81998c97f25b3201c are later rename/extraction changes.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED: 3030b4afe30f96b59807b24bd4f5250d41de283f is an ancestor of netty-4.1.0.Final and netty-4.2.0.Final, and netty-4.1.134.Final contains the vulnerable native function. The PUBLISHED CVE record identifies versions before 4.1.135.Final and 4.2.0.Final through 4.2.14.Final as affected.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: 652663cb50c3be6378969be2cf84472743e0109f is not an ancestor of netty-4.1.134.Final but is an ancestor of netty-4.1.135.Final; 89aa20ad1c5356b44e1294a59ec05e1ab1fe5924 is not an ancestor of netty-4.2.14.Final but is an ancestor of netty-4.2.15.Final.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: direct fixes 652663cb50c3be6378969be2cf84472743e0109f (4.1) and 89aa20ad1c5356b44e1294a59ec05e1ab1fe5924 (4.2) reset the msghdr, walk SCM_RIGHTS cmsgs, close unexpected descriptors, and return errors for truncation or invalid multiplicity.
